panels.general_description: Photograph of a paper growth chart on a printed grid with curved reference lines, a dotted plotted line and handwritten numbers.
panels.detailed_description: A photographed sheet of grid paper (the page edges show white background, and the photo is slightly angled). Several smooth curved lines run diagonally down the sheet: two red curves and several black curves, one of which has small tick marks. A dotted line made of small dots follows a stepped, downward-sloping path and carries many small handwritten numbers beside it in blue and black ink. A column of handwritten numbers with circled entries runs down the left edge in blue ink. Printed axis labels and the handwritten numbers are not reliably legible at this resolution. The letter (a) is printed at the lower left.

limitations: Photograph of a handwritten paper chart; axis labels, tick values and handwritten entries are not reliably legible, so no values are transcribed.

visual.detailed_description: Panel (a) on top has two axial CT slices side by side with printed region-of-interest statistics, distances and scanner text. Panel (b) below has three microphotographs in a row, the middle labelled Masson's trichrome and the right labelled Reticulin.

panels.general_description: Two side-by-side axial contrast-enhanced abdominal CT images with printed measurements and scanner text around a rounded anterior liver lesion.
panels.detailed_description: Two axial abdominal CT slices of the same level on black backgrounds, in a blue-green display. The left slice has a small circle marking a region of interest within a rounded, mottled lesion at the front of the abdomen, with printed statistics above it. The right slice shows the same lesion crossed by two perpendicular measurement lines, with printed distances above. The spine, kidneys and abdominal wall are visible in both slices. Printed text on the right slice includes scanner name lines at the upper right. Both slices carry the printed label Portal Venous and the letter A below, the letter R at the left of each slice, a 10cm scale bar and window text at the lower right of each. The caption letter (a) is printed below the pair.

No scale bar is visible.
